title: The document-set result, the rendering hand-off, the party set and the case trigger are not specified for rwb-treatment
source: Legacy RWB-E3-018 (04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md heading RWB-E3-018); FSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v3 A2.18; TSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v2 T3.1, T4 DEEDINLIEU and RESTRUCTURE and T-A.1; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-TRT-18; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DIL-14, R-RES-10 and R-RES-13; context pack S2 (ownership rows of S2); Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-03, DP-05, DP-13 and DP-19
section: 3 Preconditions; 4 Flow; 7 Acceptance criteria AC1 to AC4; 8 Business rules; 11 Data; 12.1; 12.4; 12.7; 13 Solution plan; 14 Validation and messages
description: One combined row for the treatment document set. (1) The set has no field anywhere: TSD S2 T3.1 gives treatment DF-TRT-001 to DF-TRT-033 and none of them is a document set, a set status, a template code, a template version or a completion time, and FSD S2 A2.18 has no field catalog at all, so the set can only live in an answer and in the decision record. (2) No source states how the set is composed for a treatment type: R-DIL-14 and R-RES-10 say generate the documents and the four types the legacy AC1 names are the agreement, the contract, the credit approval and the mortgage document, but the mapping of a treatment type to its set is not written anywhere. (3) The rendering is not attributed: the legacy story had the document rows in the same schema (DF-DOC-001 to DF-DOC-011) and the target gives document, document_type and document_hub_parameter to rwb-document and the template catalogue to rwb-comms, while the Work Package records no C dependency for this pair, so whether this story calls the generation operation itself or consumes the activity of RWB-S2-E2026-APP is unstated. (4) The trigger is not stated in the target: the legacy AC2 and AC3 start from the case states TRANSFER_PRICE_SET and WITH_FCR_OFFICER, which are rwb-case's, and no source says how a stage is told the case reached them. (5) The party set the documents are issued to is named only as the v_ace_customer range DF-ACE-055 to DF-ACE-074, with no statement whether rwb-treatment reads it or receives the party values from the engine. (6) No source gives a message text for a withdrawn template, for an unmatched treatment type or for a set refused by the engine.
evidence: TSD S2 v2 T3.1 (treatment fields DF-TRT-001 to DF-TRT-033, no set, template-version or set-status field); TSD S2 v2 T4 DEEDINLIEU (R-DIL-14 TRANSFER_PRICE_SET PRICE_INSIDE_FLOOR to OFFER_WITH_CUSTOMER_DIL) and RESTRUCTURE (R-RES-10 WITH_FCR_OFFICER OFFER_PREPARED to AWAITING_CREDIT_APPROVAL, R-RES-13 APPROVAL_SLA_BREACHED self-loop); TSD S2 v2 T-A.1 (API-S2-001 to API-S2-004, none of them a set operation) and T5.2 (P5 for documents); legacy RWB-E3-018 data table (recovery_case, assignment, v_ace_customer DF-ACE-055 to DF-ACE-074, treatment DF-TRT-001 to DF-TRT-014, document DF-DOC-001 to DF-DOC-011, decision_log_entry DF-DEC-001 to DF-DEC-018) and acceptance criteria AC2 and AC3 (then generate the credit approval, the contract and the mortgage documents; then the case moves to OFFER_WITH_CUSTOMER_DIL; then the case moves to AWAITING_CREDIT_APPROVAL); Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DIL-14 (systems: the Workbench document hub, WIN and DMS, Workbench; offer validity 14 days) and R-RES-10 (Workbench; 3 working days); FSD S2 v3 A2.18.2 (integration points: Workbench, the Workbench document hub); context pack S2 (ownership rows of S2: table treatment, four REST operations, event EV-10, workflow TreatmentWorkflow)
area: Contract and data: set composition, rendering hand-off, party set, case trigger, message texts
owner_role: Tech lead of rwb-treatment with the P5 owner of the document contract, the P6 owner of the template catalogue and the P3 owner of the case contract
proposed: Apply the working read of ASM-B2-S2-013-1, ASM-B2-S2-013-2 and ASM-B2-S2-013-3 with RWB-S2-E3018-CON and RWB-S2-E3018-APP: the set is composed per treatment type from the catalogue value in force, the rendering is the generateContractDocument activity of RWB-S2-E2026-APP against the published RWB-P5-E2026-CON so this pair records no C dependency, the party set is read as keys and a count from the service's own v_ace_customer view, the case status arrives on the signal the parent CaseWorkflow forwards, and the set outcome travels in the answer section and the local decision record. Confirm the catalogue access with the P6 owner and the hand-off with the P5 owner at the wave 2 contract freeze.

title: The published shape of the document-set section, of the set request and of the status vocabulary has no source
source: Legacy RWB-E3-018 (04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md heading RWB-E3-018); FSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v3 A2.18; TSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v2 T3.1 and T-A.1 to T-A.2; Template and Rules v1 R7.2 s12 and R5.5 DP-05
section: 3 Preconditions; 7 Acceptance criteria AC1 to AC6; 9 State transitions; 11 Data; 12.1; 12.7; 12.8; 13 Solution plan
description: A contract row with nothing to copy. (1) No source names a document-set resource, a set section or a set element, so the section name, its properties, the element of one document and the split between stored, returned and computed properties are unpublished. (2) No source states whether the set answer is served inside the treatment read, on a sub-path of its own or through a separate read, and the TSD endpoint inventory stops at the four treatment operations. (3) No source names the element in which the stage hands the set to the rendering engine, so the request name, its properties, the party count and the way the template version travels are unpublished. (4) No source gives the status vocabulary of a set: the legacy story names the treatment outcome values KEPT, BROKEN, COMPLETED, CANCELED and DECLINED and nothing that describes a document set. (5) No source gives the error answers of a read that carries an optional section, and the legacy message table names six identifiers of the module without mapping them to status codes.
evidence: TSD S2 v2 T3.1 (no set element and no template-version field; LOV-TRT-OUTCOME holds KEPT, BROKEN, COMPLETED, CANCELED, DECLINED only) and T-A.1 (four treatment operations, no set read); FSD S2 v3 A2.18 (main success flow AC-S2-018-01 with no field catalog) and A2.18.3.1 (rules R-DIL-14, R-RES-10 and R-RES-13 only); legacy RWB-E3-018 endpoints table (POST /cases/{caseId}/treatments and GET /treatments/{treatmentId} only) and validation table (MSG-S2-001, MSG-S2-002, MSG-S2-003, MSG-GEN-001, MSG-P4-002, MSG-P7-003 with no status code); Template and Rules v1 R7.2 s12 (tables 12.1 to 12.9) and R5.5 DP-05
area: Contract: set section, set request element, status vocabulary, error set
owner_role: Solution architect with the rwb-treatment tech lead, the P5 owner of the document contract and the P6 owner of the template catalogue
proposed: Publish the working read of ASM-B2-S2-013-4 as the rwb-treatment contract v1: an optional documentSet section of the answer of GET /treatments/{treatmentId} at the same major version with setStatus, composedAt, ruleId, ruleVersion, reasonCode and a documents array of documentType, templateCode, templateVersion, documentId, docVersion and documentStatus; a DocumentSetRequest element with the case and treatment references, the rule and version, and one entry per required type with its code, version and party count; the status vocabulary COMPLETE, INCOMPLETE, REFUSED and UNMATCHED; and 401, 403 with MSG-P4-002, 404, 422 with MSG-GEN-001 and 503 for the errors. Confirm the section with the owner of RWB-S2-E3001-CON and the request with the P5 owner at the wave 2 contract freeze.
